install.description: Adds NetBird's apt repository, installs the agent and joins the mesh with the setup key from the vault. When the agent is already connected, it only re-asserts up.
install.title: Install NetBird

uninstall.description: Disconnects the agent, purges the package and removes the apt repository. No-op when not installed.
uninstall.title: Uninstall NetBird

update.description: Upgrades the NetBird agent package. No-op when current.
update.title: Update NetBird

verify.description: Read-only check that the agent is installed and connected to the mesh. Exits non-zero when it is not.
verify.title: Verify NetBird

description: Installs and manages the NetBird mesh agent from NetBird's apt repository and joins the mesh with a one-time setup key. Secrets come from the vault: the setup key is a secret slot, never a profile value. Targets Debian 12/13 and Ubuntu 22.04/24.04.
name: netbird
title: NetBird
